operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Creates a purchase debit note. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token. It requires the **Inventory** plugin to be active.

A purchase debit note shares storage with purchase orders and is identified by its document type, so **`type` must be `14`** — sending a different type (or omitting it) fails with a `400` (`"error": "Record Not Found"`) because the entity can only be resolved for type `14`.

### Request body

The body is a flat JSON object. The account layer enforces exactly three required fields — omitting any of them returns `422`:

| Field | Requirement |
|---|---|
| `supplier_business_name` | Required, non-empty. |
| `draft` | Required. `1` = save as draft, `0` = finalized. |
| `summary_total.currency` | Required, non-empty (the currency of the totals object). |

In addition, `type` must be `14` for the record to save (enforced below the validation layer with a `400`).

All other fields are optional. `no` (the debit-note number) is generated automatically when omitted. `currency_code` and `supplier_id` are optional. Server-managed fields (`id`, `created`, `modified`, `branch_id`, `site_id`, `staff_id`, payment/summary totals) are assigned by the server.

### Line items

Line items are sent under the **`purchase_debit_notes_items`** array (each entry becomes a purchase-order-item row). Each item takes `product_id`, `item` (name), `description`, `unit_price`, `quantity`, `discount`, `discount_type`, `tax1`, `tax2`, and optional `col_3`..`col_5` extra columns.

### Statuses

`requisition_delivery_status`:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Received |
| 2 | Rejected |
| 3 | Pending |
| 4 | Partially Received |
| 5 | Partially Rejected |

On success the response is `{ "message": "...", "id": <new id> }`; the message is localized to the caller's language.

draft.description:
Required. Whether to save the document as a draft.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Draft |
| 0 | Finalized |

type.description: Required. Document type. Must be `14` (purchase debit note); any other value returns a `400` (`Record Not Found`).

currency.description: Required, non-empty. Currency code of the totals (e.g. `EGP`).

currency_code.description: Optional. Currency code of the document (e.g. `EGP`).

no.description: Optional. Debit-note number. Generated automatically when omitted.

staff_id.description: Optional. Id of the staff member. Defaults to the authenticated user.

work_order_id.description: Optional. Id of a linked work order.

requisition_delivery_status.description:
Optional. Requisition delivery status.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Received |
| 2 | Rejected |
| 3 | Pending |
| 4 | Partially Received |
| 5 | Partially Rejected |

tags.description: Optional. Tags to assign to the document.

purchase_debit_notes_items.description: Line items. Each entry is persisted as a purchase-order-item row.

discount_type.description:
Discount type.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Percentage |
| 2 | Fixed amount |

tax1.description: Id of the first tax applied to the item, or null.

tax2.description: Id of the second tax applied to the item, or null.

200.description: The purchase debit note was created.

id.description: Id of the newly created purchase debit note.

400.description: The record passed validation but could not be saved — most commonly because `type` was missing or not `14` (`"error": "Record Not Found"`).

e.description: Error detail (an object for database-level failures, or an empty array for other save failures).

error.description: Reason the record could not be saved. `Record Not Found` is returned when `type` is missing or not `14`.

401.description: The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

422.description: A required field failed validation. `errors` maps each failing field (`supplier_business_name`, `draft`, `summary_total.currency`) to its messages.

errors.description: Map of field name to an array of error messages. Returned when `supplier_business_name`, `draft`, or `summary_total.currency` is missing or empty.
